    {
        $this->application->supprimerMedecin($id);
    }
}

All that remains here is to specify which methods to call (the methods of [ApplicationModel]) and which labels to display (the [MEDECINS.xxx] keys in the dictionaries), and to provide the starting paths and route names (line 14). [ApplicationModel] is located in the [$this->application] property, declared by the parent class’s constructor. [ClientsController] is identical, with the client methods and the [CLIENTS.xxx] keys.

docs.title: 11.19.6. src/Controller/InscriptionController.php
docs.text:
<?php
// =========================================================================
// src/Controller/InscriptionController.php: "Create a customer account": a patient
// who does not yet have an account creates one themselves. Routes PUBLIQUES (we do not
// an account yet, by definition):
//
//    POST /registration/log  in "Create a customer account" button on the
//                              authentication page: verifies the CAPTCHA from CETTE
//                              page, then opens the form
//    GE T /registrat        ion the form
//    POST /registrati        on create an account, then return to the login page
//
// The page is protected against bots by the UN CAPTCHA on the
// authentication page:
//    1. The "Create a Customer Account" button sends the login form to
//       /registration/access; if the CAPTCHA is entered correctly, the server issues a
//       token (see src/Securite/PasseInscription.php);
//    2. Without a valid token, /registration redirects to the
//       authentication page (attribute #[PasseInscriptionExige], see
//       src/EventListener/VerifierPasseInscription.php);
//    3. The token is consumed upon creation: a solved CAPTCHA allows you to
//       create UN an account;
//    4. Additionally, the number of accounts created per hour per address IP is limited
//       (see src/Securite/LimiteurTentatives.php).
//
// The account created is exactly the one that ADMIN would create from the "Clients" page
// (same business-layer method: ajouterClient), except that the patient
// CHOISIT their username and password (required, with confirmation).
// =========================================================================

namespace App\Controller;

use App\Form\ChampsPersonneType;
use App\Form\InscriptionType;
use App\Metier\MetierException;
use App\Securite\CaptchaService;
use App\Securite\LimiteurTentatives;
use App\Securite\PasseInscription;
use App\Securite\PasseInscriptionExige;
use App\Web\ApplicationModel;
use App\Web\Controleur;
use App\Web\Flash;
use App\Web\Message;
use Symfony\Component\Form\FormInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\Routing\Attribute\Route;

#[Route('/inscription')]
class InscriptionController extends Controleur
{
    public function __construct(
        private ApplicationModel $application,
        private CaptchaService $captchas,
        private LimiteurTentatives $limiteur,
        private PasseInscription $passes,
        private Flash $flash,
    ) {
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /registration/l  ogin fields: captchaId, CAPTCHA (those on the
     // authentication page; login and password, which are also sent, are ignored)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     #[Route('/acces', name: 'inscription_acces', methods: ['POST'])]
    public function acces(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->verifierCsrf($request);
        $ip = (string) $request->getClientIp();

         // Too many accounts have been created recently from this address: no need to proceed further
        $minutes = $this->limiteur->minutesBlocageInscription($ip);
        if ($minutes > 0) {
            $this->flash->erreur('ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ACCOUNTS', ['minutes' => $minutes]);
            return $this->redirectToRoute('login');
        }

         // Captcha missing or incorrect: return to the login page, with a
         // new image (a failed attempt counts as a failed login)
        if (! $this->captchas->verifier($request->request->getString('captchaId'),
            $request->request->getString('captcha'))) {
            $this->limiteur->echecLogin($ip, '');
            $this->flash->erreur('ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
            return $this->redirectToRoute('login');
        }

         // Correct CAPTCHA: the passcode is issued and the form is opened
        $reponse = $this->redirectToRoute('inscription');
        $reponse->headers->setCookie($this->passes->emettre());
        return $reponse;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /registration: the form; POST /registration: creation. The
     // The token has been verified AVANT the action is called (#[PasseInscriptionExige]).
     // The form validates TOUTE the input (fields and password confirmation):
     // The user corrects all errors at once
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     #[Route('', name: 'inscription', methods: ['GET', 'POST'])]
     #[PasseInscriptionExige]
    public function inscription(Request $request): Response
    {
        $formulaire = $this->createForm(InscriptionType::class, ['titre' => 'Mr']);
        $formulaire->handleRequest($request);
        if (! $formulaire->isSubmitted() || ! $formulaire->isValid()) {
            return $this->page($formulaire);
        }
        $ip = (string) $request->getClientIp();

         // 1. Have too many accounts been created recently from this address?
        $minutes = $this->limiteur->minutesBlocageInscription($ip);
        if ($minutes > 0) {
            return $this->page($formulaire, new Message('ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ACCOUNTS', ['minutes' => $minutes]));
        }

         // 2. Creation (customer + account USER, in a transaction)
        $donnees = ChampsPersonneType::donnees($formulaire->getData());
        try {
            $this->application->ajouterClient($donnees);
        } catch (MetierException $e) {
             // username or first name + last name already taken: the pass remains valid
            return $this->page($formulaire, new Message($e->cle, $e->parametres),
                PersonnesController::CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[$e->cle] ?? []);
        }

         // 3. The passcode has been used: it cannot be used to create a second account
        $this->passes->consommer($request->cookies->get(PasseInscription::COOKIE));
        $this->limiteur->inscriptionReussie($ip);

         // 4. Return to the login page; username pre-filled
        $this->flash->succes('INSCRIPTION.DONE', ['login' => $donnees->login]);
        return PasseInscription::effacerCookie($this->redirectToRoute('login', ['login' => $donnees->login]));
    }

     // The form; a rejected form: error code 422
    private function page(FormInterface $formulaire, ?Message $erreur = null, array $champsInvalides = []): Response
    {
        $refuse = $erreur !== null || ($formulaire->isSubmitted() && ! $formulaire->isValid());
        return $this->render('inscription.html.twig', ['titrePage' => 'INSCRIPTION.TITLE',
            'formulaire' => $formulaire, 'erreur' => $erreur, 'champsInvalides' => $champsInvalides],
            new Response(status: $refuse ? 422 : 200));
    }
}

The patient creates a customer account themselves. The flow is protected by a CAPTCHA, the same one used on the login page.

  • Lines 65–91: The “Create a Customer Account” button on the login page submits the login form to this address (later, the view [login]). If too many accounts have been created recently from this address (IP), there’s no need to proceed further. If the CAPTCHA is missing or incorrect: return to the login page with a new image and a message; the failure counts as a failed login attempt (with an empty username). If the CAPTCHA is correct: a token is stored in a cookie, and the user is redirected to the form;
  • lines 99–107: the form. The [#[PasseInscriptionExige]] attribute (line 100) causes the token to be verified by the listener [VerifierPasseInscription] before the action is called. The form validates all input, including the password confirmation: the user sees all errors at once;
  • Lines 108–132: creation. The client and their account are created using the same business-layer method as for the administrator ([ajouterClient]); only the username and password are chosen by the patient. If a username or a homonym is already taken: return to the form without consuming the pass. Creating an account consumes the token (one solved CAPTCHA equals one account), counts toward the hourly limit, and redirects to the login page with the username pre-filled ([redirectToRoute('login', ['login' => ...])] adds the parameter [?login=...]), along with a success message. The pass cookie is cleared.

docs.title: 11.19.7. src/Controller/EspaceController.php
docs.text:
<?php
// =========================================================================
// src/Controller/EspaceController.php: the patient’s pages (role
// USER), the one they see immediately after logging in:
//
//    GE T /my-space               home page: [Gérer mon compte], [View a
//                                   calendar], and his upcoming appointment
//    POST /my-space/cancel        cancels the appointment SON
//    GE T /my-accou              nt account modification form
//    POST /my-accoun              t update
//    POST /my-account/delete      delete account (and its appointments)
//
// Golden rule for this controller: the patient in question is TOUJOURS, the one associated with the token
// ($this->tools->patientConnecte()), never an identifier sent by the
// browser. A patient can therefore neither view, modify, nor cancel what
// belongs to another patient, even if they create their own requests.
//
// Any modification or deletion of the account requires the password ACTUEL:
// so that someone who finds a session left open cannot change the
// password nor delete the account. Incorrect entries of the current password are
// counted as login failures (same limit).
//
// Security: All of these URL are reserved for the USER role (rule ^/my- from
// config/packages/security.yaml).
// =========================================================================

namespace App\Controller;

use App\Entity\Client;
use App\Entity\Rv;
use App\Form\ChampsPersonneType;
use App\Form\MonCompteType;
use App\Metier\MetierException;
use App\Securite\AuthService;
use App\Securite\LimiteurTentatives;
use App\Vues\RendezVousVue;
use App\Web\ApplicationModel;
use App\Web\Controleur;
use App\Web\Flash;
use App\Web\Message;
use App\Web\Outils;
use Symfony\Component\Form\FormError;
use Symfony\Component\Form\FormInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\Routing\Attribute\Route;
use Symfony\Contracts\Translation\TranslatorInterface;

class EspaceController extends Controleur
{
    public function __construct(
        private ApplicationModel $application,
        private AuthService $auth,
        private LimiteurTentatives $limiteur,
        private Outils $outils,
        private Flash $flash,
        private TranslatorInterface $traducteur,
    ) {
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /my-space
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     #[Route('/mon-espace', name: 'espace', methods: ['GET'])]
    public function espace(): Response
    {
        $patient = $this->outils->patientConnecte();
        $rendezVous = array_map(fn (Rv $rv) => new RendezVousVue(
            $rv->getId(),
            $this->outils->formaterJour($rv->getJour()),
            $rv->getCreneau()->horaire(),
            $rv->getCreneau()->getMedecin()->libelle(),
             // link to the doctor’s schedule for that day: the patient sees their name there
            $this->generateUrl('agenda', ['idMedecin' => $rv->getCreneau()->getMedecin()->getId(),
                'jour' => Outils::iso($rv->getJour())])),
            $this->application->getRvAVenirClient($patient->getId()));
        return $this->render('espace.html.twig', ['titrePage' => 'ESPACE.TITLE',
            'patient' => $patient->libelle(), 'rendezVous' => $rendezVous]);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /my-space/cancel   field: idRv
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     #[Route('/mon-espace/annuler', name: 'espace_annuler', methods: ['POST'])]
    public function annulerRv(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->verifierCsrf($request);
        $patient = $this->outils->patientConnecte();
        $idRv = Outils::entierPositif($request->request->get('idRv'));
        $rv = $idRv !== null ? $this->application->getRvById($idRv) : null;
         // an appointment that doesn’t exist, and that of a AUTRE patient, receive the
         // same response: we do not disclose information about other patients’ appointments
        if ($rv === null || $rv->getClient()->getId() !== $patient->getId()) {
            $this->flash->erreur('ERRORS.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND');
        } else {
            $this->application->supprimerRv($rv);
            $this->flash->succes('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
        }
        return $this->redirectToRoute('espace');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /my-account: the form, pre-filled with the patient’s information;
     // POST /my-account: the modification
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     #[Route('/mon-compte', name: 'compte', methods: ['GET', 'POST'])]
    public function compte(Request $request): Response
    {
        $patient = $this->outils->patientConnecte();
        $formulaire = $this->createForm(MonCompteType::class, [
            'titre' => $patient->getTitre(), 'prenom' => $patient->getPrenom(), 'nom' => $patient->getNom(),
            'login' => $patient->getCompte()->getLogin(), 'version' => $patient->getVersion(),
        ]);
        $formulaire->handleRequest($request);
        if (! $formulaire->isSubmitted() || ! $formulaire->isValid()) {
            return $this->page($formulaire);
        }

         // the current password; incorrect: the message will go to SOUS the field (an error
         // added to the field (FormError), and at the bottom of the page
        $erreur = $this->verifierMotDePasseActuel($request, $patient,
            $formulaire->get('current_password')->getData());
        if ($erreur !== null) {
            $formulaire->get('current_password')->addError(
                new FormError($this->traducteur->trans($erreur->cle, $erreur->parametres)));
            return $this->page($formulaire, $erreur);
        }

        try {
            $client = $this->application->modifierClient($patient->getId(),
                ChampsPersonneType::donnees($formulaire->getData()));
        } catch (MetierException $e) {
            return $this->page($formulaire, new Message($e->cle, $e->parametres),
                PersonnesController::CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[$e->cle] ?? []);
        }
         // the login and display name are DANS; the token: a new one is issued,
         // otherwise the navigation bar would retain the old name
        $this->flash->succes('MON_COMPTE.UPDATED');
        $reponse = $this->redirectToRoute('espace');
        $reponse->headers->setCookie($this->auth->cookieJeton($client->getCompte()));
        return $reponse;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /my-account/delete   field: current_password
     // The account, the client, and TOUS their appointments are all deleted, and then the
     // the patient is logged out.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     #[Route('/mon-compte/supprimer', name: 'compte_supprimer', methods: ['POST'])]
    public function supprimerCompte(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->verifierCsrf($request);
        $patient = $this->outils->patientConnecte();
        $erreur = $this->verifierMotDePasseActuel($request, $patient,
            $request->request->getString('current_password'));
        if ($erreur !== null) {
            $this->flash->erreur($erreur->cle, $erreur->parametres);
            return $this->redirectToRoute('compte');
        }
        $this->application->supprimerClient($patient->getId());
        $this->flash->succes('MON_COMPTE.DELETED');
        return AuthService::effacerCookie($this->redirectToRoute('login'));
    }

     // ----------------------------------------------------------------- internal functions

     // the account page; a rejected form: code 422
    private function page(FormInterface $formulaire, ?Message $erreur = null, array $champsInvalides = []): Response
    {
        $refuse = $erreur !== null || ($formulaire->isSubmitted() && ! $formulaire->isValid());
        return $this->render('compte.html.twig', ['titrePage' => 'MON_COMPTE.TITLE',
            'formulaire' => $formulaire, 'erreur' => $erreur, 'champsInvalides' => $champsInvalides],
            new Response(status: $refuse ? 422 : 200));
    }

     // null if the current password is correct; otherwise, the error message
    private function verifierMotDePasseActuel(Request $request, Client $patient, ?string $motDePasse): ?Message
    {
        $ip = (string) $request->getClientIp();
        $login = $patient->getCompte()->getLogin();
        $minutes = $this->limiteur->minutesBlocageLogin($ip, $login);
        if ($minutes > 0) {
            return new Message('ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS', ['minutes' => $minutes]);
        }
        if (! $motDePasse || $this->auth->valider($login, $motDePasse) === null) {
            $this->limiteur->echecLogin($ip, $login);
            return new Message('ERRORS.WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD');
        }
        return null;
    }
}

The patient’s personal pages. The golden rule for this controller: the patient in question is always the one associated with the token ([Outils::patientConnecte]), never an identifier sent by the browser. A patient cannot therefore view, modify, or cancel information belonging to another patient, even by crafting their own requests.

  • lines 64–79: My Space: the patient’s name and their upcoming appointments, formatted ([RendezVousVue]), each with a link to the doctor’s schedule for that day;
  • lines 84–100: the cancellation of his appointment. Both a nonexistent appointment and another patient’s appointment receive the same response: no information is disclosed about other patients’ appointments (not even their existence);
  • lines 106–117: the “Manage My Account” form, pre-filled with the patient’s information, and its submission;
  • lines 119–142: the modification. Any modification requires the current password: someone who found a session left open would be unable to change the password or do anything else. If the current password is incorrect, the form is redisplayed, with the message below the field and at the bottom of the page. [addError(new FormError(...))] adds an error to a field, as if the validation had detected it (example 18); its message is text that has already been translated, hence the translation received by the builder ([TranslatorInterface], example 22). After the modification, a new token is generated: the login and the displayed name are included in the token, and the navigation bar would otherwise retain the old name until the next login;
  • lines 149–163: deletion of the account, the client, and all their appointments, using the same business-logic method as for the administrator. This second form on the page is hand-coded (a single field, the current password), with the application’s anti-CSRF token. The patient is then logged out (the token cookie is cleared);
  • lines 177–190: Verification of the current password. This is subject to the attempt limiter, just like a login: without this, someone with an open session could try thousands of passwords via the “Manage My Account” form and discover the correct one.

docs.title: 11.20. The Views
docs.text: The [Twig] views in the [templates] folder: a template, fragments, macros, and pages.

docs.title: 11.20.1.1. templates/layout.html.twig
docs.text:
<!doctype html>
{# =========================================================================
   templates/layout.html.twig
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Le gabarit COMMUN à toutes les pages (cf. exemple 15) : chaque page
   (agenda.html.twig, login.html.twig...) l'ÉTEND ({% extends %}) et remplit son
   bloc [contenu].

   Twig ÉCHAPPE tout ce qu'il affiche avec {{ ... }} (les caractères < > & " '
   deviennent < >...) : protection contre l'injection de HTML via un nom
   saisi, par exemple. Pour insérer du HTML tel quel, il faut le demander
   explicitement (filtre raw, cf. fragments/captcha.html.twig).

   Messages : un succès s'affiche en HAUT de la page, une erreur en BAS, sur fond
   rose léger (fragment erreurs).

   Le gabarit partage les variables de la page : [titrePage] (la clé du titre de
   la page, transmise par l'action). La langue de la page est celle de la requête
   (app.request.locale, cf. src/EventListener/FixerLangue.php).
   ========================================================================= #}
<html lang="{{ app.request.locale }}">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  {# titrePage|trans: the translation of a key; here, the key is VARIABLE #}
  <title>{{ titrePage|trans }} - {{ 'APP.TITLE'|trans }}</title>
  {# asset(): the URL of a file in the public folder #}
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ asset('lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css') }}">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ asset('css/styles.css') }}">
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container py-4">
    {% include 'fragments/navbar.html.twig' %}
    {% include 'fragments/succes.html.twig' %}
    <main>
      {% block contenu %}{% endblock %}
    </main>
    {% include 'fragments/erreurs.html.twig' %}
  </div>
  {# the "Are you sure?" window, hidden until needed #}
  {% include 'fragments/confirmation.html.twig' %}
  <script src="{{ asset('js/app.js') }}"></script>
</body>
</html>

The template common to all pages (Example 15): each page extends it ([{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}]) and fills in its [contenu] block (line 36).

  • Line 21: the page’s language, [fr] or [en]: the language of the request, set by the listener [FixerLangue]. [app] is the global variable that [Symfony] provides to all views (Example 15);
  • line 26: the page title, translated: [titrePage|trans] translates the key contained in the variable [titrePage], which each action passes to its view;
  • lines 28–29: the function [asset] returns the URL from a file in the [public] folder (Example 15);
  • lines 33–38: the navigation bar, the success messages at the top of the page, the page content, and the error area at the bottom of the page. These fragments are inserted by [{% include %}] (Example 15): they access the page’s variables;
  • lines 41–42: the “Are you sure?” window, hidden until needed, and the script that displays it.

[Twig] escapes everything it displays using [{{ ... }}] (Example 13): an entered name containing HTML ([<script>]) is displayed as-is, without being interpreted. This is protection against the effortless injection of HTML (XSS) into all pages.

docs.title: 11.20.1.2. templates/fragments/navbar.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/fragments/navbar.html.twig - la barre de navigation.

   Titre, FR/EN, rôle, nom, déconnexion - et un menu dont les entrées dépendent
   du rôle : "Médecins" et "Clients" n'apparaissent que pour l'ADMIN. Ce n'est
   qu'un confort d'affichage : la vraie protection, ce sont les règles d'accès
   (un USER qui tape /medecins à la main obtient une page 403). Un patient (USER)
   a en plus son menu "Mon espace".

   utilisateur() : l'utilisateur connecté, ou null (cf. src/Twig/VuesExtension.php).
   Le menu de la page courante est mis en évidence (classe "active") : il l'est si
   le chemin de l'URL (app.request.pathInfo) commence par ([starts with]) l'un des
   préfixes de l'entrée. Les entrées du menu : une liste de tableaux [nom de la
   route, clé du libellé, préfixes des chemins pour lesquels l'entrée est active].
   ========================================================================= #}
{% set utilisateur = utilisateur() %}
{% set menu = [] %}
{% if utilisateur %}
  {% if utilisateur.estPatient %}
    {# active for /my-space ET /my-account #}
    {% set menu = menu|merge([['espace', 'APP.MENU_MY_SPACE', ['/mon-']]]) %}
  {% endif %}
  {% set menu = menu|merge([['agenda', 'APP.MENU_AGENDA', ['/agenda']]]) %}
  {% if utilisateur.estAdmin %}
    {% set menu = menu|merge([['medecins_liste', 'APP.MENU_DOCTORS', ['/medecins']],
                              ['clients_liste', 'APP.MENU_PATIENTS', ['/clients']]]) %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
<nav class="navbar navbar-expand-sm navbar-dark bg-primary rounded mb-4 px-3">
  <span class="navbar-brand mb-0">{{ 'APP.TITLE'|trans }}</span>

  <ul class="navbar-nav me-auto">
    {# entree[0]: the road name; the filter retains the appropriate prefixes #}
    {% for entree in menu %}
    {% set active = entree[2]|filter(p => app.request.pathInfo starts with p) is not empty %}
    <li class="nav-item">
      <a class="nav-link{{ active ? ' active' }}" href="{{ path(entree[0]) }}">{{ entree[1]|trans }}</a>
    </li>
    {% endfor %}
  </ul>

  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
    {# FR / EN: simple links (GET /language/fr), with the active language highlighted #}
    <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group" aria-label="FR / EN">
      {% for code in ['fr', 'en'] %}
      <a class="btn {{ app.request.locale == code ? 'btn-light' : 'btn-outline-light' }}"
         href="{{ path('langue', {code: code}) }}">{{ code|upper }}</a>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>

    {% if utilisateur %}
    <span class="badge text-bg-light text-primary">{{ utilisateur.role.value }}</span>
    <span class="text-white">{{ utilisateur.nom }}</span>
    {# logout is a POST: a form reduced to its button (and the anti-CSRF token) #}
    <form method="post" action="{{ path('logout') }}" class="m-0">
      <input type="hidden" name="_token" value="{{ csrf_token('rdvmedecins') }}">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-light">{{ 'APP.LOGOUT'|trans }}</button>
    </form>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</nav>

The navigation bar. The menu items depend on the role: “My Account” for a patient, “Doctors” and “Clients” for the administrator. This is merely a convenience feature: the real protection comes from the rules [access_control] (a patient who types [/medecins] manually will receive a 403 page).

  • Line 16: the logged-in user, or [null], returned by the [utilisateur()] function in our extension;
  • Lines 17–28: The menu is generated by the [{% set %}] instructions, which produce a list of entries: the route name, the label key, and the path prefixes for which the entry is active. The filter [merge] returns a new list, consisting of the elements from the first list followed by those from the second (for two associative arrays, it combines their keys). [utilisateur.estPatient]: [Twig] calls the method [estPatient()]. The entry “My Space” is active for [/mon-espace] and [/mon-compte] (prefix [/mon-]). This is borderline with the “no logic in views” rule: however, this logic only affects the display and is used only here;
  • Lines 34–39: For each entry, [active] is true if the path of the requested URL ([app.request.pathInfo]) begins with ([starts with]) one of the entry’s prefixes. The filter [filter] retains only those elements of a list that satisfy a condition, written as an arrow function ([p => ...]);
  • lines 44–49: the buttons FR / EN, which are simple links ([/langue/fr]), with the active language highlighted;
  • lines 51–59: for a logged-in user, their role ([utilisateur.role.value]: the enumeration case string), their name, and the logout button. Logout is a request POST: a form reduced to its button, with its anti-CSRF token ([csrf_token('rdvmedecins')], example 21).

docs.title: 11.20.1.3. templates/fragments/succes.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/fragments/succes.html.twig - les messages de SUCCÈS déposés par
   l'action précédente (rendez-vous enregistré, médecin ajouté...), affichés une
   seule fois, en haut de la page (cf. src/Web/Flash.php). Un message flash
   d'ERREUR, lui, est affiché en bas de la page, par le fragment erreurs.

   app.flashes('succes') : les messages flash de ce type (cf. exemple 20). Chaque
   message est un objet Message : message.cle|trans(message.parametres) est le texte
   de la clé, où {nom}, {login}... sont remplacés par leurs valeurs.
   ========================================================================= #}
{% for message in app.flashes('succes') %}
<div class="alert alert-success" role="status">{{ message.cle|trans(message.parametres) }}</div>
{% endfor %}

The success flash messages, set by the previous action ([Flash::succes]), are read and removed from the session by [app.flashes('succes')] (Example 20). Each is a [Message] object, translated here into the page’s language: [message.cle|trans(message.parametres)]. [role="status"]: A screen reader announces the message.

docs.title: 11.20.1.4. templates/fragments/erreurs.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/fragments/erreurs.html.twig - la zone d'erreur, en BAS de chaque
   page, sur fond rose léger (classe .zone-erreur, cf. public/css/styles.css).

   Elle regroupe les trois sources d'erreur possibles :
     - [erreur] : l'erreur de la page affichée (date invalide, captcha mal
       recopié, login déjà pris...), transmise par l'action ;
     - les messages flash d'erreur, déposés par l'action précédente avant une
       redirection (créneau déjà réservé, suppression refusée...) ;
     - les erreurs de saisie d'un formulaire invalide (cf. exemple 19) : leurs
       messages sont affichés SOUS les champs ; ici, s'il n'y a pas d'autre
       message, une simple phrase « Le formulaire contient des erreurs. ».

   erreur ?? null : la variable n'existe pas dans toutes les pages.
   role="alert" : un lecteur d'écran annonce le message dès l'affichage de la
   page, même s'il se trouve en bas.
   ========================================================================= #}
{% set messages = app.flashes('erreurs') %}
{% if erreur ?? null %}
  {% set messages = [erreur]|merge(messages) %}
{% endif %}
{% if messages is empty and formulaire is defined and formulaire.vars.submitted and not formulaire.vars.valid %}
  {% set messages = [{cle: 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM', parametres: []}] %}
{% endif %}
{% if messages is not empty %}
<div class="zone-erreur" role="alert">
  {% for message in messages %}
  <div>{{ message.cle|trans(message.parametres) }}</div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% endif %}

The error area, at the bottom of each page, on a light pink background. It combines the three possible sources of error:

  • flash error messages, generated by the previous action (a time slot already reserved, an expired session, etc.);
  • the error on the displayed page ([erreur]), transmitted by the action: an invalid date, a misspelled CAPTCHA, a username already in use, etc.; placed at the top of the list. [erreur ?? null]: this variable does not exist on all pages; the operator [??] does not flag a nonexistent variable—it replaces it with [null];
  • Input errors in an invalid form (example 19): their messages are displayed below the fields; here, if there are no other messages, a simple phrase: “The form contains errors.” On a long form, this lets the user know they need to scroll back up. [formulaire.vars]: the properties of the form view, including [submitted] (submitted?) and [valid] (valid?). The message is written as an associative array with the same keys as the properties of a [Message]: for [Twig], [message.cle] refers to both the key of an array and the property of an object.

[role="alert"]: A screen reader announces the message as soon as the page is displayed, even if it is at the bottom. The area remains fixed at the bottom of the window when the page is long (see the stylesheet below).

docs.title: 11.20.1.5. templates/fragments/confirmation.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
     templates/fragments/confirmation.html.twig - la fenêtre modale
     "Êtes-vous sûr ?" (cf. exemple 21).

     Elle remplace la boîte window.confirm() du navigateur, qu'on ne peut ni mettre
     en forme, ni traduire (ses boutons restent dans la langue du navigateur, pas
     dans celle de la page).

     Une SEULE fenêtre pour toute la page, cachée (d-none) au départ. Ses libellés
     sont traduits ici, par le serveur, comme le reste de la page ; le petit script
     public/js/app.js se contente de l'afficher, d'y placer le message propre au
     formulaire (attribut data-confirmation), et d'envoyer le formulaire si
     l'utilisateur confirme.
     ========================================================================= #}
<div id="modale-confirmation" class="d-none">
  <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
  <div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true"
       aria-labelledby="modale-confirmation-titre" aria-describedby="modale-confirmation-message">
    <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
      <div class="modal-content">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <h5 class="modal-title" id="modale-confirmation-titre">{{ 'CONFIRMATION.TITLE'|trans }}</h5>
          <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-action="non" aria-label="{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA'|trans }}"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body">
          <p class="mb-0" id="modale-confirmation-message"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-footer">
          {# "No, go back" rather than "Cancel": the question is sometimes
               « Annuler ce rendez-vous ? », et un bouton "Annuler" y serait ambigu #}
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-action="non">{{ 'CONFIRMATION.NO'|trans }}</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" data-action="oui">{{ 'CONFIRMATION.YES'|trans }}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

The “Are you sure?” modal window from Example 21, which replaces the browser’s [window.confirm()] dialog box: this dialog box does not format correctly, and its buttons remain in the browser’s language, not the page’s language. A single window for the entire page, initially hidden (class [d-none] derived from [Bootstrap]); its labels are translated by the server, just like the rest of the page. The [public/js/app.js] script displays it, places the message from the form to be confirmed inside it (its [data-confirmation] attribute), and submits the form if the user confirms. The "Decline" button is labeled “No, go back” rather than “Cancel”: the question is sometimes “Cancel this appointment?”, and a “Cancel” button would be ambiguous in that context.

docs.title: 11.20.1.6. templates/fragments/reservation.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/fragments/reservation.html.twig - la fenêtre de réservation de
   l'agenda.

   Les VRAIES classes Bootstrap d'une fenêtre modale (.modal, .modal-backdrop...),
   rendues visibles "en dur" (show d-block) plutôt que par le JavaScript de
   Bootstrap. C'est le SERVEUR qui décide de l'afficher (paramètre &reserver=...
   de l'URL), et la fermer revient à suivre un lien vers la même page sans ce
   paramètre.

   Le fragment lit directement les variables de la page qui l'insère
   (reservation, idMedecin, jour, urlRetour).
   ========================================================================= #}
<div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
<div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="titre-reservation">
  <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
    <form method="post" action="{{ path('agenda_reserver') }}" class="modal-content">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h5 class="modal-title" id="titre-reservation">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE'|trans }}</h5>
        <a class="btn-close" href="{{ urlRetour }}" aria-label="{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA'|trans }}"></a>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-body">
        <p>{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT'|trans({horaire: reservation.horaire}) }}</p>

        {# what else the server needs to know besides the selected patient #}
        <input type="hidden" name="_token" value="{{ csrf_token('rdvmedecins') }}">
        <input type="hidden" name="idMedecin" value="{{ idMedecin }}">
        <input type="hidden" name="jour" value="{{ jour }}">
        <input type="hidden" name="idCreneau" value="{{ reservation.idCreneau }}">

        {# A patient makes a reservation for themselves: no list to choose from (and the
           serveur ignore de toute façon un éventuel idClient) #}
        {% if reservation.patient %}
        <p class="mb-0">
          <span>{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL'|trans }}</span> :
          <strong>{{ reservation.patient }}</strong>
        </p>
        {% else %}
        <label class="form-label" for="idClient">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL'|trans }}</label>
        <select id="idClient" name="idClient" class="form-select" required autofocus>
          <option value="">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT'|trans }}</option>
          {% for client in reservation.clients %}
          <option value="{{ client.id }}">{{ client.libelle }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>
        {% endif %}
      </div>

      <div class="modal-footer">
        <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="{{ urlRetour }}">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL'|trans }}</a>
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{ 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM'|trans }}</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>

The calendar booking window. It uses the actual classes of a modal window from [Bootstrap] ([modal], [modal-backdrop]...), but made visible "hard-coded" ([show d-block]), rather than through the [JavaScript] of [Bootstrap]: it is the server that decides to display it when URL contains [&reserver=...]. Closing it (using the X or the Cancel button) is equivalent to following a link to the same page without that parameter ([urlRetour]).

  • Lines 27–30: the anti-CSRF token, and what the server needs to know: the doctor, the day, and the time slot;
  • Lines 34–47: A patient enters their own name without selecting from a list (and the server ignores any [idClient] field anyway). The administrator and doctors select the patient from a list; [required] and [autofocus]: the browser requires a selection and places the cursor in the list.

docs.title: 11.20.1.7. templates/fragments/captcha.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/fragments/captcha.html.twig - le captcha de la page
   d'authentification (cf. src/Securite/CaptchaService.php). Il protège à la fois
   la connexion et l'accès à la création de compte (bouton "Créer un compte
   client"). Il lit la variable [captcha] de la page.

   captcha.svg|raw : l'image SVG est insérée TELLE QUELLE dans la page, sans
   échappement. C'est sans danger ici parce que ce SVG est fabriqué par le serveur
   lui-même et ne contient rien qui vienne de l'utilisateur - on ne ferait JAMAIS
   cela avec une saisie.

   Le champ caché captchaId dit au serveur QUEL captcha vérifier ; la bonne
   réponse, elle, n'est jamais envoyée au navigateur. "Autre image" recharge
   simplement la page (path('login') : l'URL de la page, sans ses paramètres).
   ========================================================================= #}
<div class="mb-3">
  <label class="form-label" for="captcha">{{ 'CAPTCHA.LABEL'|trans }}</label>
  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
    <div class="captcha-image" role="img" aria-label="{{ 'CAPTCHA.IMAGE_ALT'|trans }}">{{ captcha.svg|raw }}</div>
    <a class="small" href="{{ path('login') }}">{{ 'CAPTCHA.NEW_IMAGE'|trans }}</a>
  </div>
  <input type="hidden" name="captchaId" value="{{ captcha.id }}">
  <input id="captcha" name="captcha" type="text" maxlength="10" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off"
         spellcheck="false" required class="form-control">
  <div class="form-text">{{ 'CAPTCHA.HELP'|trans }}</div>
</div>

The CAPTCHA (example 27). [captcha.svg|raw] inserts the image SVG as-is, without escaping it: otherwise, the browser would display its code XML. This is safe here because this SVG is generated by the server and contains nothing provided by the user: we would never do this with user input. The hidden field [captchaId] tells the server which CAPTCHA to verify; the response itself is never sent to the browser. The “Other image” link reloads the login page—and thus the CAPTCHA.

docs.title: 11.20.2. Macros: templates/macros.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/macros.html.twig - les macros des formulaires (cf. exemple 15).

   champ(champ, champsInvalides) : un champ d'un formulaire du composant Form,
   avec son libellé, son message d'erreur ou son aide (form_row, dessiné par le
   thème Bootstrap 5, cf. exemple 18). Le champ est encadré en rouge (classe
   is-invalid) s'il a une erreur de saisie (le thème s'en charge), ou si une erreur
   MÉTIER le désigne : son nom est dans la liste [champsInvalides] transmise par
   l'action (un login déjà pris...), le message étant en bas de page.
   Les attributs du champ (maxlength...) sont complétés, pas remplacés : merge.
   ========================================================================= #}
{% macro champ(champ, champsInvalides = []) %}
  {% set attr = champ.vars.attr %}
  {% if champ.vars.name in champsInvalides %}
    {% set attr = attr|merge({class: (attr.class|default('') ~ ' is-invalid')|trim}) %}
  {% endif %}
  {{ form_row(champ, {attr: attr}) }}
{% endmacro %}

{# the identity fields (title, first name, last name), common to three forms:
   médecin/client de l'ADMIN, "Créer un compte client" et "Gérer mon compte" #}
{% macro identite(formulaire, champsInvalides = []) %}
  {# import _self: macros from the CE file, to call the field macro #}
  {% import _self as m %}
  {{ m.champ(formulaire.titre, champsInvalides) }}
  <div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-sm-6">{{ m.champ(formulaire.prenom, champsInvalides) }}</div>
    <div class="col-sm-6">{{ m.champ(formulaire.nom, champsInvalides) }}</div>
  </div>
{% endmacro %}

Two macros (Example 15), used by the three pages that display a “person” form.

  • Lines 12–18: A field in a Form component form, generated by [form_row] (Example 18): its label, input field, error message, or tooltip, along with the classes from the [Bootstrap] 5 theme declared in [config/packages/twig.yaml]. The theme highlights a field with an input error in red (class [is-invalid]). The macro also adds it to a field identified by an error from the business layer: the list [champsInvalides] passed by the action ([PersonnesController::CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER]). A username that is already taken is not an input error (it has the correct format), but the user needs to see which field to correct. [champ.vars]: the field view properties, including its name ([name]) and its attributes HTML ([attr]); these are appended ([merge]), not replaced: the field retains its [maxlength]. The second parameter of [form_row] replaces the field view properties;
  • Lines 22–30: the identity fields, common to three forms: the title, followed by the first name and last name side by side (the grid from [Bootstrap]: [row], [col-sm-6]). A macro cannot see the other macros in its file: [{% import _self as m %}] (line 24) imports them.

docs.title: 11.20.3.1. templates/login.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/login.html.twig - le formulaire de connexion (cf. AuthController).
   Un <form> HTML ordinaire, écrit à la main : le navigateur envoie lui-même login,
   mot de passe et réponse au captcha en POST /login, sans JavaScript. En cas
   d'échec, le serveur renvoie CETTE page, avec le login déjà saisi, un NOUVEAU
   captcha et l'erreur, affichée en bas de page par le gabarit.
   ========================================================================= #}
{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}

{% block contenu %}
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ 'LOGIN.TITLE'|trans }}</h5>

      <form method="post" action="{{ path('connexion') }}">
        <input type="hidden" name="_token" value="{{ csrf_token('rdvmedecins') }}">
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="login">{{ 'LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL'|trans }}</label>
          {# autofocus: a Boolean attribute, set if the condition is true, omitted
             sinon. Le curseur va au premier champ à remplir #}
          <input id="login" name="login" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="username"
                 value="{{ login }}" required{{ login == '' ? ' autofocus' }}>
        </div>
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="password">{{ 'LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL'|trans }}</label>
          <input id="password" name="password" type="password" class="form-control"
                 autocomplete="current-password" required{{ login != '' ? ' autofocus' }}>
        </div>

        {% include 'fragments/captcha.html.twig' %}

        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{ 'LOGIN.SUBMIT'|trans }}</button>

        {# No account yet: a patient can create one themselves. This is not
           PAS un simple lien : c'est un second bouton d'envoi de CE formulaire,
           qui part vers une autre adresse (formaction). Le serveur y vérifie le
           captcha ci-dessus avant d'ouvrir la page de création de compte (cf.
           InscriptionController). formnovalidate : le navigateur n'exige pas
           login et mot de passe (inutiles pour créer un compte). Entrée dans un
           champ déclenche toujours le PREMIER bouton du formulaire, "Se connecter". #}
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3"
                formaction="{{ path('inscription_acces') }}" formnovalidate>{{ 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT'|trans }}</button>
        <div class="form-text text-center">{{ 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP'|trans }}</div>
      </form>

      <div class="text-muted small mt-3">
        <span>{{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS'|trans }}</span>
        <ul class="mb-0 mt-1">
          <li><code>admin</code> - <span>{{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN'|trans }}</span></li>
          <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - <span>{{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR'|trans }}</span></li>
          <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - <span>{{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_USER'|trans }}</span></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

The login form, a hand-coded [<form>], is sent via POST to [/login] (the path [connexion]).

  • Lines 22–28: The entered username is redisplayed after a failed login attempt ([login]). The attribute [autofocus] places the cursor in the first field to be filled in: the username if it is empty, or the password otherwise (after a failed attempt or after creating an account). [{{ login == '' ? ' autofocus' }}]: The ternary operator without “else” returns an empty string if the condition is false;
  • line 31: the CAPTCHA;
  • lines 42–43: the “Create a Customer Account” button is not a link; it is a second button that submits the same form to a different address (button attribute [formaction]). The server verifies the CAPTCHA there before opening the account creation page ([InscriptionController::acces]). [formnovalidate]: The browser does not require a username and password (attributes [required]), as they are not needed to create an account. Pressing the Enter key in a field always triggers the first form submission button: Log In.

docs.title: 11.20.3.2. templates/agenda.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/agenda.html.twig - la page principale (cf. AgendaController).
   Trois blocs :
     1. le choix du médecin et du jour ;
     2. l'agenda ;
     3. la fenêtre de réservation (fragment reservation).
   Une éventuelle erreur (date invalide, médecin inconnu) est affichée en bas de
   la page par le gabarit (fragment erreurs).
   ========================================================================= #}
{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}

{% block contenu %}
  {# 1. Selection of doctor and day: a GET form, which simply reloads
        cette page avec ?idMedecin=...&jour=... dans l'URL #}
  <form method="get" action="{{ path('agenda') }}" class="card p-3 mb-3">
    <div class="row g-2 align-items-end">
      <div class="col-sm-5">
        <label class="form-label" for="idMedecin">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL'|trans }}</label>
        <select id="idMedecin" name="idMedecin" class="form-select" required>
          <option value="">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR'|trans }}</option>
          {% for medecin in medecins %}
          <option value="{{ medecin.id }}"{{ medecin.selectionne ? ' selected' }}>{{ medecin.libelle }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-4">
        <label class="form-label" for="jour">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL'|trans }}</label>
        <input id="jour" name="jour" type="date" class="form-control" value="{{ jour }}" required>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-3">
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{ 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_AGENDA'|trans }}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>

  {# patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no "Book" button #}
  {% if info %}
  <div class="alert alert-info">
    <span>{{ info|trans }}</span>
    <a href="{{ path('espace') }}" class="alert-link">{{ 'APP.MENU_MY_SPACE'|trans }}</a>
  </div>
  {% endif %}

  {# 2. The calendar #}
  {% if agenda %}
  <div class="card p-3">
    <h5>{{ 'AGENDA.TITLE_PREFIX'|trans }} {{ agenda.jour }} - {{ agenda.medecin }}</h5>

    {% if agenda.lignes is not empty %}
    <table class="table table-hover align-middle">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{{ 'AGENDA.COLUMN_SLOT'|trans }}</th>
          <th>{{ 'AGENDA.COLUMN_STATUS'|trans }}</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {% for ligne in agenda.lignes %}
        <tr{{ ligne.reservable ? ' class="creneau-libre"' }}>
          <td>{{ ligne.horaire }}</td>
          <td>
            {# [patient] is only populated if the user has permission to view this
               nom (ADMIN, DOCTOR, ou le patient pour SON rendez-vous) - sinon,
               simplement « Réservé » #}
            {% if ligne.libre %}
            <span class="badge text-bg-success">{{ 'AGENDA.FREE'|trans }}</span>
            {% elseif ligne.patient %}
            <span class="badge {{ ligne.moi ? 'text-bg-primary' : 'text-bg-secondary' }}">{{ ligne.patient }}</span>
            {% else %}
            <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">{{ 'AGENDA.BOOKED_BY_OTHER'|trans }}</span>
            {% endif %}
          </td>
          <td>
            {# The buttons displayed are determined by the controller (bookable,
               idRv) selon le rôle de l'utilisateur. "Réserver" est un simple
               lien : il rouvre cette page avec la fenêtre de réservation de ce créneau #}
            {% if ligne.reservable %}
            <a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" href="{{ ligne.urlReserver }}">{{ 'AGENDA.BOOK'|trans }}</a>
            {% endif %}
            {# "Cancel" MODIFIE data: this is therefore a POST #}
            {% if ligne.idRv %}
            <form method="post" action="{{ path('agenda_annuler') }}" class="m-0"
                  data-confirmation="{{ 'AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'|trans }}">
              <input type="hidden" name="_token" value="{{ csrf_token('rdvmedecins') }}">
              <input type="hidden" name="idRv" value="{{ ligne.idRv }}">
              <input type="hidden" name="idMedecin" value="{{ idMedecin }}">
              <input type="hidden" name="jour" value="{{ jour }}">
              <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger">{{ 'AGENDA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT'|trans }}</button>
            </form>
            {% endif %}
          </td>
        </tr>
        {% endfor %}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <p class="text-muted mb-0">{{ 'AGENDA.NO_SLOTS'|trans }}</p>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
  {% else %}
  <p class="text-muted">{{ 'AGENDA.EMPTY_STATE'|trans }}</p>
  {% endif %}

  {# 3. the reservation window, only if the URL contains &reserve=... #}
  {% if reservation %}
  {% include 'fragments/reservation.html.twig' %}
  {% endif %}
{% endblock %}

The main page. Three sections: selecting a doctor and a day, the calendar, and the booking window.

  • Lines 15–34: Selecting a doctor and a day: a GET form (Example 17), which reloads the page with [?idMedecin=...&jour=...] in the URL. The day is a [type="date"] field: the browser displays a calendar and sends the date in [aaaa-mm-jj] format, regardless of how it is displayed ([26/09/2026] in French);
  • lines 37–42: for a patient who already has an upcoming appointment, why there is no “Book” button;
  • lines 66–72: the slot status: Available (in green), the patient’s name (in blue for the appointment of the logged-in patient, in gray otherwise), or “Booked.” The view does not make any decisions: [ligne.patient] is only populated if the user has permission to view that name;
  • lines 78–80: “Book” is a simple link: it reopens the page with the booking window for that time slot ([ligne.urlReserver]). It does not modify anything: a GET is sufficient;
  • lines 82–91: “Cancel” modifies data: it is a POST form (example 21), with its anti-CSRF token, the appointment to be canceled, and information to return to the same page (the doctor, the day). The [data-confirmation] attribute causes the page’s script to request confirmation;
  • lines 106–108: the booking window, if requested by URL (and if the time slot is available for booking).

docs.title: 11.20.3.3. templates/people/liste.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/personnes/liste.html.twig - la liste des médecins OU des clients
   (ADMIN). Une seule vue pour les deux : les clés des libellés propres à chacun
   arrivent dans [cles], et [section] ("medecins" ou "clients") donne le début des
   noms des routes (cf. PersonnesController) : section ~ '_ajout' -> "medecins_ajout".
   ========================================================================= #}
{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}

{% block contenu %}
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
    <h4 class="mb-0">{{ cles.titre|trans }}</h4>
    <a class="btn btn-primary" href="{{ path(section ~ '_ajout') }}">{{ cles.ajouter|trans }}</a>
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3">
    {% if personnes is not empty %}
    <table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONNES.COLUMN_TITLE'|trans }}</th>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONNES.COLUMN_FIRSTNAME'|trans }}</th>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONNES.COLUMN_LASTNAME'|trans }}</th>
          <th>{{ 'PERSONNES.COLUMN_LOGIN'|trans }}</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {# personne.titre: Twig calls the getTitre() accessor (see Example 13) #}
        {% for personne in personnes %}
        <tr>
          <td>{{ personne.titre }}</td>
          <td>{{ personne.prenom }}</td>
          <td>{{ personne.nom }}</td>
          <td><code>{{ personne.compte.login }}</code></td>
          <td class="text-end">
            <div class="d-inline-flex gap-2">
              <a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary"
                 href="{{ path(section ~ '_modification', {id: personne.id}) }}">{{ 'PERSONNES.EDIT'|trans }}</a>
              {# data-confirmation: a confirmation window will open before
                 l'envoi du formulaire (cf. public/js/app.js) #}
              <form method="post" action="{{ path(section ~ '_supprimer', {id: personne.id}) }}" class="m-0"
                    data-confirmation="{{ cles.confirmerSuppression|trans }}">
                <input type="hidden" name="_token" value="{{ csrf_token('rdvmedecins') }}">
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger">{{ 'PERSONNES.DELETE'|trans }}</button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
        {% endfor %}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <p class="text-muted mb-0">{{ cles.vide|trans }}</p>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
{% endblock %}

The list of doctors or clients: the labels specific to each one are translation keys ([cles]), and the route names are generated from the section name ([path(section ~ '_modification', {id: personne.id})]: the operator [~] concatenates, resulting in [medecins_modification] or [clients_modification]). [personne.compte.login]: the account login, populated with the list (layer DAO). The Delete button is a POST form, with confirmation.

docs.title: 11.20.3.4. templates/people/formulaire.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/personnes/formulaire.html.twig - création OU modification d'un
   médecin ou d'un client (ADMIN), avec le formulaire PersonneType.

   Quand la saisie est refusée (champ vide, login déjà pris...), l'action
   réaffiche CETTE page, et la vue montre :
     - les valeurs déjà saisies (sauf le mot de passe) ;
     - les champs fautifs encadrés en rouge (classe Bootstrap "is-invalid") ;
     - sous un champ refusé par la validation, son message ;
     - le message d'erreur de la page, EN BAS de la page (fragment erreurs).
   form_start écrit la balise <form> (méthode POST, URL de la page) ; form_end, la
   fin du formulaire, avec les champs qui n'ont pas encore été écrits : le jeton
   anti-CSRF, et, en modification, le champ caché de la version (le verrou optimiste).
   ========================================================================= #}
{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}
{% import 'macros.html.twig' as m %}

{% block contenu %}
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ titrePage|trans }}</h5>

      {{ form_start(formulaire) }}
        {# form_errors: errors in the form itself (invalid anti-CSRF token) #}
        {{ form_errors(formulaire) }}
        {# title, first name, last name: a macro shared by three forms #}
        {{ m.identite(formulaire, champsInvalides) }}

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ 'PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'|trans }}</h6>
        {{ m.champ(formulaire.login, champsInvalides) }}
        {# never pre-filled: the password is never sent back to the browser #}
        {{ m.champ(formulaire.password) }}

        <div class="d-flex gap-2 mt-4">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{ 'PERSONNES.SAVE'|trans }}</button>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="{{ urlListe }}">{{ 'PERSONNES.BACK'|trans }}</a>
        </div>
      {{ form_end(formulaire) }}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

Creating or editing a doctor or a client using the [PersonneType] form.

  • Line 16: Importing macros under the name [m];
  • Line 24: [form_start] writes the tag [<form>]: the method POST, the page’s URL, and the attribute [novalidate] (type option [attr]);
  • line 26: [form_errors(formulaire)] displays errors in the form itself that do not relate to any specific field: an invalid anti-CSRF token (“The page has expired...”);
  • line 28: title, first name, and last name, via the [identite] macro;
  • lines 31–33: the username and password, which are never pre-filled. Their tooltips differ between creation and modification (type options);
  • line 39: [form_end] closes the form after writing the fields that have not yet been written: the anti-CSRF token, and, when editing, the hidden version field (the optimistic lock).

docs.title: 11.20.3.5. templates/inscription.html.twig

{# =========================================================================
   templates/inscription.html.twig - "Créer un compte client" (page publique, cf.
   InscriptionController), avec le formulaire InscriptionType. Mêmes champs
   d'identité que le formulaire de l'ADMIN (macro identite), mais le login et le
   mot de passe sont obligatoires, avec confirmation. Pas de captcha ICI : on
   n'arrive sur cette page qu'après avoir recopié celui de la page
   d'authentification (bouton "Créer un compte client").

{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}

      {{ form_start(formulaire) }}

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ 'PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'|trans }}</h6>
        {{ m.champ(formulaire.login, champsInvalides) }}

</div>

Creating a customer account: the identity fields, followed by the username, password, and password confirmation, which are required. The two fields in the repeated field are [formulaire.password.first] and [formulaire.password.second] (lines 27–28), placed side by side. The password help text specifies the minimum length: “At least 6 characters.” There is no CAPTCHA here: you can only reach this page after entering the CAPTCHA from the login page.

docs.title: 11.20.3.6. templates/espace.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/espace.html.twig - "Mon espace" : la page d'accueil du patient (rôle
   USER), affichée juste après sa connexion.
     - deux options : [Gérer mon compte] et [Voir un agenda] ;
     - son rendez-vous à venir, s'il en a un, avec le moyen de l'annuler.
   ========================================================================= #}
{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}

{% block contenu %}
  <h4 class="mb-3">{{ 'ESPACE.HELLO'|trans({nom: patient}) }}</h4>

  <div class="row g-3 mb-4">
    <div class="col-sm-6">
      <a class="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none carte-option" href="{{ path('compte') }}">
        <h5 class="mb-1">{{ 'ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT'|trans }}</h5>
        <span class="text-muted">{{ 'ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP'|trans }}</span>
      </a>
    </div>
    <div class="col-sm-6">
      <a class="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none carte-option" href="{{ path('agenda') }}">
        <h5 class="mb-1">{{ 'ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA'|trans }}</h5>
        <span class="text-muted">{{ 'ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA_HELP'|trans }}</span>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3">
    <h5>{{ 'ESPACE.MY_APPOINTMENT'|trans }}</h5>
    {# Normally only one (rule: “one upcoming appointment at a time”), but the
       page sait en afficher plusieurs. {% for %} ... {% else %} : une boucle, et
       ce qu'on affiche si la liste est vide ; loop.last : dernier élément ? #}
    {% for rv in rendezVous %}
    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 py-2{{ not loop.last ? ' border-bottom' }}">
      <div>
        <div class="fw-semibold">{{ rv.jour }}, {{ rv.horaire }}</div>
        <div class="text-muted">
          <span>{{ rv.medecin }}</span> -
          <a href="{{ rv.urlAgenda }}">{{ 'ESPACE.SEE_IN_AGENDA'|trans }}</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <form method="post" action="{{ path('espace_annuler') }}" class="m-0"
            data-confirmation="{{ 'AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'|trans }}">
        <input type="hidden" name="_token" value="{{ csrf_token('rdvmedecins') }}">
        <input type="hidden" name="idRv" value="{{ rv.id }}">
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-outline-danger">{{ 'ESPACE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT'|trans }}</button>
      </form>
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <p class="text-muted mb-0">{{ 'ESPACE.NO_APPOINTMENT'|trans }}</p>
    {% endfor %}
  </div>
{% endblock %}

“My Space,” the patient’s home page: two large cards (“Manage My Account,” “View Calendar”), and their upcoming appointment.

  • Lines 32–50: [{% for %}] ... [{% else %}] (Example 14) is a loop, followed by what to display if the list is empty. Normally, a patient has at most one upcoming appointment; however, the page is capable of displaying multiple appointments. [loop.last] (Example 14): the last item has no separator;
  • each appointment has a cancellation form (POST, with confirmation), which sends only its ID: the server will verify that it belongs to the logged-in patient.

docs.title: 11.20.3.7. templates/compte.html.twig
docs.text:
{# =========================================================================
   templates/compte.html.twig - "Gérer mon compte" (rôle USER).
   Deux formulaires indépendants sur la même page :
     1. la modification (identité, login, nouveau mot de passe facultatif), avec
        le formulaire MonCompteType ;
     2. la suppression du compte - qui annule aussi ses rendez-vous : un
        formulaire écrit à la main.
   L'un comme l'autre exigent le mot de passe ACTUEL (champ current_password).
   ========================================================================= #}
{% extends 'layout.html.twig' %}
{% import 'macros.html.twig' as m %}

{% block contenu %}
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">

    {# 1. modification #}
    <div class="card p-4 mb-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.TITLE'|trans }}</h5>

      {{ form_start(formulaire) }}
        {{ form_errors(formulaire) }}
        {{ m.identite(formulaire, champsInvalides) }}

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ 'PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'|trans }}</h6>
        {{ m.champ(formulaire.login, champsInvalides) }}
        <div class="row g-3">
          <div class="col-sm-6">{{ m.champ(formulaire.password.first) }}</div>
          <div class="col-sm-6">{{ m.champ(formulaire.password.second) }}</div>
        </div>
        {{ m.champ(formulaire.current_password) }}

        <div class="d-flex gap-2 mt-4">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{ 'PERSONNES.SAVE'|trans }}</button>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="{{ path('espace') }}">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.BACK'|trans }}</a>
        </div>
      {{ form_end(formulaire) }}
    </div>

    {# 2. deletion. The password field has the same NOM as the first one
       formulaire (current_password), mais un autre id : deux éléments d'une même
       page ne peuvent pas avoir le même id #}
    <div class="card p-4 border-danger">
      <h5 class="card-title text-danger mb-1">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.DELETE_TITLE'|trans }}</h5>
      <p class="text-muted small">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.DELETE_HELP'|trans }}</p>
      <form method="post" action="{{ path('compte_supprimer') }}" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 align-items-end"
            data-confirmation="{{ 'MON_COMPTE.DELETE_CONFIRM'|trans }}">
        <input type="hidden" name="_token" value="{{ csrf_token('rdvmedecins') }}">
        <div class="flex-grow-1">
          <label class="form-label" for="mot_de_passe_suppression">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL'|trans }}</label>
          <input id="mot_de_passe_suppression" name="current_password" type="password" maxlength="72"
                 autocomplete="current-password" required class="form-control">
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.DELETE_SUBMIT'|trans }}</button>
      </form>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

“Manage My Account”: two independent forms on the same page.

  • Lines 18–38: the update, using the [MonCompteType] form: the identity fields, the login, the new password and its confirmation (optional), and the current password (required). The version (optimistic lock) is set by [form_end];
  • Lines 43–56: Account deletion, a handwritten form with its own current password field and a confirmation field. The field is named [current_password] (the field in the first form is named [mon_compte[current_password]]: the Form component prefixes its field names with the form name), and its own unique ID: two elements on a page cannot have the same ID, as indicated by the [for] attribute of a label.
